components.label: All-in-one body
components.purpose: Four-channel standalone system, 878 wide × 466.1 deep × 118.4 high mm and 13 kg, with grab handles at both ends.
components.limits: Envelope and weight are retailer copies of the Pioneer table.

components.label: Left jog wheel with On Jog Display
components.purpose: Full-size jog wheel with a colour display in its centre; left deck controls deck 1 or 3.
components.limits: Diameter not stated on the product page (seed: 206 mm).

components.label: Right jog wheel with On Jog Display
components.purpose: Full-size jog wheel with a colour display; right deck controls deck 2 or 4.

components.label: 7-inch touch screen
components.purpose: 7-inch LCD touch screen for browsing and waveforms, with the browse knob beside it.

components.label: 16 performance pads
components.purpose: Eight multicolour pads per deck for Hot Cue, Beat Loop, Slip Loop and Beat Jump.

components.label: 4-channel mixer section
components.purpose: Four channel strips with 3-band EQ and colour FX, crossfader, 14 Beat FX and 6 Sound Color FX, 3-band master EQ and a mic feedback reducer.

components.label: USB device ports (top, ×2)
components.purpose: Two top-loading USB ports for sticks or drives prepared with rekordbox.

components.label: USB laptop port
components.purpose: One USB port for a laptop: Serato DJ Pro or rekordbox Link Export, up to two laptops at once with the LINK port.

components.label: LINK · Pro DJ Link
components.purpose: Ethernet LINK port so external CDJs or a laptop join channels 3 and 4 over Pro DJ Link.

components.label: MASTER OUT · XLR and RCA
components.purpose: Balanced XLR and unbalanced RCA master pairs.
components.limits: Standard XDJ layout; counts not machine-read from the manual.

components.label: Channel 3/4 LINE / PHONO inputs · RCA
components.purpose: RCA pairs for channels 3 and 4, switchable line/phono, with a signal ground post, for CDJs or turntables.
components.limits: Channels 3 and 4 take external sources per the product page; pair count per channel is not machine-read.

components.label: MIC 1 and MIC 2
components.purpose: Two microphone inputs (combo and 1/4-inch) with a feedback reducer on the mixer.

components.label: AC IN
components.purpose: IEC mains inlet and power switch.

page.practice_cards:
Simulated XDJ-XZ state



Connections and controls
Each button only reads back what the manufacturer document says that connector or control does.


Four decks from one box
Decks 1 and 2 are the jogs. Decks 3 and 4 come from the LINE/PHONO inputs, a Pro DJ Link player on the LINK port, or a laptop on USB running rekordbox or Serato.
The XZ can take the CDJ-3000s on channels 3 and 4 if the A9 is out.
